title: Paper 1 scope and epistemic-boundary evidence pack

accepted_artifacts.label: Manuscript v0.1 snapshot
accepted_artifacts.note: Working manuscript only; not independent evidence of its own quantitative statements.

conflicts_and_limitations: The manuscript is a working snapshot and is not independent evidence for its own quantitative statements.
The ontology's specific candidate dimensions and interaction functions remain revisable where marked provisional.
The cited artifacts establish intended scope and method boundaries, not full source-corpus closure.
No held-out real-world prediction benchmark or causal identification result is included in this pack.
wording_ceiling: Paper 1 formalizes a bounded Zhongzhou-school source corpus into a traceable and auditable latent-state representation and evaluates internal formalization properties. It does not establish real-world predictive accuracy, causal validity, or a physical mechanism for qi.
forbidden_inferences: Internal rule fidelity proves real-world predictive accuracy.
The operational latent-state representation proves qi is a physical energy.
The existence of a draft manuscript proves all reported counts and metrics are independently validated.
The N/E/S/A/C trajectory model is a canonical Zhongzhou rule or an empirically validated law.
Textbook case reconstruction is equivalent to blind prospective prediction.
